chunk.text: Women care The Company shall indemnify the Out-Patient Medical Expenses incurred by the female Insured Person up to the limit specified in the Policy Schedule, through cashless facility towards Diagnosis within the Policy Year for the following: a) Mammography b) Cervical Cancer screening c) PCOS/PCOD diagnostic tests Note: This benefit is available only for women insured members aged 18 years and above. Mental Health wellbeing The Company shall indemnify the Out Patient Medical Expenses incurred by the Insured Person up to the limit specified in the Policy Schedule, through cashless facility towards Consultation, Counseling and rehabilitation of the Insured Person, within the Policy Year for the following: a) Acute depression b) Obsessive compulsive disorder c) Anxiety d) Post traumatic stress disorder 4. Exclusions

Notification of Claim means the process of intimating a Claim to the Insurer or TPA through any of the recognized modes of communication. OPD Treatment is one in which the Insured Person visits a clinic/Hospital or associated facility like a consultation room for diagnosis and treatment based on the advice of a Medical Practitioner. The Insured is not admitted as a day care or In-patient. Portability means the right accorded to individual health insurance policyholders (including all members under family cover) to transfer the credit gained for pre-existing conditions and time-bound exclusions, from one insurer to another insurer. Pre-existing Disease means any condition, ailment, injury or disease i. That is/are diagnosed by a physician within 48 months prior to the effective date of the policy issued by the insurer or its reinstatement or ii. For which medical advice or treatment was recommended by, or received from, a physician within 48 months prior to the effective date of the policy issued by insurer or its reinstatement.

appeal_draft:
To,
The Grievance Officer / Claims Review Committee

Subject: Appeal against rejection of my health insurance claim
Policy: [policy number]   Claim: CLM-80010   Date of rejection: [date of rejection]

Facts:
  - This letter informs you that the claim for mental health consultation is not covered under your policy.
  - The policy does not cover general mental health consultations. Only specific conditions like acute depression, obsessive compulsive disorder, anxiety, and post traumatic stress disorder are covered.

Policy wording relied on:
  - Clause care_supreme-0061: "The Company shall indemnify the Out Patient Medical Expenses incurred by the Insured Person up to the limit specified in the Policy Schedule, through cashless facility towards Consultation, Counseling and rehabilitation of the Insured Person, within the Policy Year for the following: a) Acute depression b) Obsessive compulsive disorder c) Anxiety d) Post traumatic stress disorder"

Reasoning:
  The policy explicitly covers only specific mental health conditions, not general consultations, which aligns with the rejection ground.

Relief sought:
  We request that the claim for the mental health consultation be reconsidered and honored as it falls under the policy's coverage for mental health conditions.

Documents to attach:
  - Copy of the claim rejection letter
  - Policy wording and policy schedule
  - Claim form and discharge summary
  - Medical bills, prescriptions and investigation reports
  - Earlier correspondence with the insurer, including any grievance acknowledgement
  - Identity proof of the policyholder

Yours faithfully,
Ms. B. Rao

Note on timing: A complaint to the Insurance Ombudsman needs a written representation to the insurer first; it must then be made within one year of the insurer's rejection, or of one month after the representation was sent (Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017, Rule 14(3), checked against the published text as amended till 09.11.2023; later amendments not checked). Confirm with the Ombudsman office before relying on a date, and compute dates with the deadline tool.

---
